name: ChillPops Jamaica
one_liner: Handcrafted Jamaican paletas (gourmet ice pops) in fruit, ice cream/fudge and alcohol-infused styles, plus soft serve with dips and toppings.
about: Founder Damir Tufail returned to Jamaica from the United States wanting to invest in Brand Jamaica. The idea came from trying a popsicle stand in the US, adapted with Jamaican fruit and flavours (Jamaica Observer, July 2022). The Negril shop opened in September 2020 after a pandemic delay (Jamaica Gleaner, June 2021). Family and friends helped; he sourced wood and built the chairs and tables himself. Local sourcing and customer feedback are published priorities. Bug Art, a Savanna-la-Mar artist, created the menu and signs, including 'dip it', 'top it' and 'nyam it'.
